q2_gaps: a static position predicate (LocatedIn, or any entity-attached surface-preposition head) with a counted/definite PLURAL subject: the instruction set fixes the group-atom-plus-per-member-rule pattern only for group EVENTS (Cardinality's distributive predicates) and for explicit universals over copular predicates, and Measures explicitly makes a plural-bearer Measure a non-distributing group aggregate - nothing says whether a position atom on a plural rides the group symbol, distributes to members by rule, or both

a solid-spelling place name whose kind morpheme is fused into the single capitalized word ("Northcove"): Core patterns licenses a type atom for "a kind word inside the name itself", but Names-and-casing illustrates only spaced names ("the Kestrel River") and Compound concepts' solid-spelling decomposition is explicitly barred for proper nouns, so whether (Member northcove cove) is licensed is undecided
notes: Bare "stand" is correctly routed to the no-event position atom, the count rides the group, and the distribution rule's range and (STV 1.0 0.9) match the counted-plural rule convention; the only open question is whether that rule and the group-level LocatedIn are both licensed for a static position predicate.
